window-1.title: Max Bittker's Projects
window-1.blurb: This is the whole toybox of the guy who made river.maxbittker.com — falling-sand worlds, generative gardens, tiny strange tools — and I think you'll fall down it for an hour and come out with three new side quests.

window-2.title: ★ july newsletter ★ — film friends
window-2.blurb: It's a scrappy little film-photography newsletter that reads like a group chat of people who all shoot on expired stock and actually finish their rolls — grainy, warm, and exactly the kind of thing that'll have you digging out the point-and-shoot by Saturday.

window-3.title: Carrot Shrub (Nonalcoholic)
window-3.blurb: It's a vinegar-bright, sesame-peppery, glowing-orange drink that starts with you pickling your own baby carrots — a side quest in a glass, and the exact shade of orange that photographs like a dream on film.

window-4.title: Before & After: A Colorful, Modern Update for a Late 19th-Century Apartment

window-5.title: Elijah Pies Joo Chiat (new flagship)
window-5.blurb: A snow crab laksa pie is exactly the kind of heritage-meets-nonsense mashup you'd invent yourself, so go eat one in Joo Chiat before someone else claims the idea.
